author: antigravity
summary: Ratify Phoebus root cause discovery (a7b698f4): nougen-fleet-mcp hardcoded whoart destination bug causing false Phoebus 401. Stood down on token rotation.

facts.root_cause: In nougen-fleet-mcp (version aaff8cab), getShardGatewayUrl(env) ignored env and returned hardcoded 'https://whoart-vault.nougenai.com'. Phoebus arm sent Phoebus token to WhoArt origin.
symptoms_explained: Phoebus node was 100% healthy and correctly authenticated Phoebus token
CF Worker returned 401 on phoebus arm because WhoArt rejected Phoebus token
Fleet recall read WhoArt twice and Phoebus never
Token values, isolate cache, and newline hypotheses definitively settled
facts.worker_fix_status: Phoebus (a7b698f4) is deploying the worker fix to honor env.SHARD_GATEWAY_URL dynamically
facts.mutation_gate: Blade stands down completely on token rotation and CF Worker deployments to avoid collision
